THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE DISTRIBUTED WITH BAZEL BUILD VISUALIZER

Bazel Build Visualizer redistributes the components below in its deploy jar.
The adjoining files preserve each upstream license and required notice under a
component-specific name so fat-jar resource collisions cannot discard them.

  License: MIT.
  License text: MATERIAL-ICON-THEME-MIT.txt
  The fixed 32-file repository-browser subset, including settings.svg, is
  redistributed unchanged.
  Project and language names and symbols may be trademarks of their owners.
  They identify file types only and do not imply endorsement or affiliation.

The separately packaged bazel.svg and bazel-folder.svg are original project artwork.
They are not part of Material Icon Theme.
They do not contain the official Bazel logo. Their labels identify Bazel and
Starlark files or Bazel-generated directory links and do not imply endorsement
or affiliation with Google or the Bazel project.

Native software bundled inside Pty4J 0.13.8

Pty4J's own upstream notice records its elt, JPty, and JNA ancestry. Its jar
also carries signed WinPTY binaries and Windows Terminal 1.22.11141.0 ConPTY
binaries even when the deploy jar is built on another host. Their notices are
therefore retained in every deploy jar:

  WinPTY
    Copyright 2011-2016 Ryan Prichard.
    Project: https://github.com/JetBrains/winpty
    License: MIT.
    License text: WINPTY-LICENSE.txt

  Windows Terminal 1.22.11141.0 (OpenConsole and ConPTY)
    Copyright Microsoft Corporation.
    Project: https://github.com/microsoft/terminal
    License: MIT.
    License and upstream third-party notice:
      WINDOWS-TERMINAL-LICENSE.txt
      WINDOWS-TERMINAL-NOTICE.md

These notices apply only to their named components. They do not change the
license of Bazel Build Visualizer.
